title: Foresee-to-Ground: From Predictive Temporal Perception to Evidence-Driven Reasoning for Video Temporal Grounding

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: F2G integrates Predictive Temporal Perception with Evidence-Driven Reasoning: it learns boundary-sensitive temporal representations to build a video-wide evidence pool of candidate event segments, and exposes these segments to the LLM as citable evidence units that bind boundary prediction to explicit event hypotheses.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: Foresee-to-Ground: From Predictive Temporal Perception to Evidence-Driven Reasoning for Video Temporal Grounding Current Video-LLM approaches for Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) typically rely on direct timestamp generation from an unstructured visual-token stream, often leading to brittle numerics and inconsistent boundaries.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: Humans do not ground temporal queries by treating videos as a continuous stream of metric time; instead, when grounding a query, we first make an explicit segment commitment (identifying the event), then refine its precise boundaries (measuring the interval).
